name: Spike Launcher
disable: DC 16 Thievery check to disable one of the four launchers or DC 12 Acrobatics check to step over a trip line (this doesn't disarm the trap, but avoids triggering it)

items.name: Spike
items.text:
Trigger A creature crosses one of the trip lines

---

Effect A spike launches along the trip line's path against the triggering creature, making a ranged Strike.

text: A jagged spike of metal shoots from a hidden launcher.
